support.boundaries: Version-specific support and source conflicts are retained in application findings and contract documentation; unknown support does not pass.

delivery.boundaries: Final Pages and live evidence recorded after the exact-source pipeline succeeds. R04 native infrastructure qualification remains open.

contracts.boundaries: Original Toolkit reader broken; corrected local conversion tested. DSC resource deployment unavailable. ARM source conflicts retained. Terraform mock tests and local Ansible validation do not qualify infrastructure deployment.

note: All 342 original source entries are retained by ID, including headings and flow connectors. Original index is immutable inventory, not 342 separate acceptance tests. Matrix outcomes and consumer boundaries govern acceptance.
